name: TwoLinesIntersection2
formula: =LAMBDA(xi,yi,xj,yj,m,C,LET(epsilon, 0.0000000001, isVertical, ABS(xj - xi) < epsilon, isHorizontal, ABS(yj - yi) < epsilon, isEqVertical, OR(ISNA(m), ABS(m) > 1000000000000000), isEqHorizontal, m = 0, verticalIntersect, IF(isVertical, LET(y, m * xi + C, IF(AND(MIN(yi, yj) - epsilon <= y, MAX(yi, yj) + epsilon >= y, NOT(isEqVertical)), HSTACK(xi, y), FALSE)), FALSE), horizontalIntersect, IF(AND(isHorizontal, NOT(isEqHorizontal)), LET(x, (yi - C) / m, IF(AND(MIN(xi, xj) - epsilon <= x, MAX(xi, xj) + epsilon >= x, NOT(isEqVertical)), HSTACK(x, yi), FALSE)), FALSE), eqVerticalIntersect, IF(isEqVertical, LET(x, C, y, yi + (x - xi) * (yj - yi) / (xj - xi), IF(AND(MIN(xi, xj) - epsilon <= x, MAX(xi, xj) + epsilon >= x, MIN(yi, yj) - epsilon <= y, MAX(yi, yj) + epsilon >= y), HSTACK(x, y), FALSE)), FALSE), dx, xj - xi, dy, yj - yi, segmentSlope, IF(isVertical, NA(), dy / dx), segmentC, yi - segmentSlope * xi, xIntersect, IF(OR(isVertical, isEqVertical), IF(isVertical, xi, C), (segmentC - C) / (m - segmentSlope)), yIntersect, IF(OR(isVertical, isEqVertical), IF(isVertical, m * xi + C, m * xIntersect + C), m * xIntersect + C), onSegment, IF(AND(xIntersect >= MIN(xi, xj) - epsilon, xIntersect <= MAX(xi, xj) + epsilon, yIntersect >= MIN(yi, yj) - epsilon, yIntersect <= MAX(yi, yj) + epsilon), HSTACK(xIntersect, yIntersect), FALSE), return, IFS(INDEX(verticalIntersect, 1, 1), verticalIntersect, INDEX(horizontalIntersect, 1, 1), horizontalIntersect, INDEX(eqVerticalIntersect, 1, 1), eqVerticalIntersect, ISERROR(INDEX(eqVerticalIntersect, 1, 1)), FALSE, INDEX(eqVerticalIntersect, 1, 1), onSegment, TRUE, FALSE), return))
